description: Dependency-aware SOL bounties for AI agents on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.29): a task graph where each task has an escrow PDA, agents submit receipts once dependencies are complete, claim rewards, and disputes are split by the graph authority. initialize_graph, create_task, fund_task, submit_receipt, claim_reward, dispute_task and resolve_dispute were verified with real devnet transactions after two disclosed lab fixes.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of Neogenuity/bountygraph. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/bountygraph. The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program and fixed two upstream bugs (fund_task rent check, resolve_dispute lamport move). The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (task graph, escrow, receipts, disputes)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/bountygraph/
QA: devnet proof of dependency-ordered bounties
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)

assignments.title: Write regression tests for the fund_task and resolve_dispute fixes
